name: 1.1.6 - Repair Order number on the clipboard
notes: Before "ez, next", the worker now copies the verified Repair Order's number to the clipboard as the number, one space and DFE (for example 01234567 DFE; leading zeros kept, nothing else), and reads it back. A Repair Order with no number yet, or a number that can't be read for sure or was copied before, is never copied: the order says CHECK BY HAND (no number yet: press Next # on it, then copy it) and the previous order's number is taken off the clipboard. The worker doesn't press Next # yet. Update the worker (and the receiver, to keep them the same); the extension (1.5.1) is unchanged.
